title: Nobody Picked Him… Until The Storm 😿

scenes.narration: Five kittens sat in a box outside the market. Four of them found homes by noon.
scenes.image_prompt: a tiny grey kitten with one white paw and big amber eyes sitting alone in a cardboard box on a busy market street, other empty space where siblings were, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: The last one was the smallest. One white paw. Everyone walked right past him.
scenes.image_prompt: close-up of a tiny grey kitten with one white paw and big amber eyes watching people's legs walk past, sad expression, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: Then the sky turned black, and the rain came down hard.
scenes.image_prompt: dark storm clouds over the market, heavy rain soaking the cardboard box, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: Under a bench, he heard crying. A little girl had lost her mother in the crowd.
scenes.image_prompt: a small girl in a yellow raincoat crying under a bench, a tiny grey kitten with one white paw and big amber eyes looking at her, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: He didn't run. He climbed into her lap and stayed, warm and purring, until she stopped shaking.
scenes.image_prompt: a tiny grey kitten with one white paw and big amber eyes curled in the lap of a girl in a yellow raincoat, both sheltering from rain, warm glow, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: When her mother finally found them, the girl wouldn't let go of him.
scenes.image_prompt: a relieved mother hugging her daughter who holds a tiny grey kitten with one white paw and big amber eyes tightly, rain easing, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: Nobody picked the smallest kitten. So he picked someone who needed him. Would you have stopped for him?
scenes.image_prompt: a tiny grey kitten with one white paw and big amber eyes asleep on a cozy bed next to a yellow raincoat, sunrise through a window, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur
